name: com.lansary/company-intelligence
title: Lansary Company Intelligence
description: Source-cited industrial company intelligence for agents. Free search, paid synthesis via x402.

tools.name: lansary_search_companies
tools.description: Free. Return relevance-ranked company candidates with entity_ref and reference_token. Inspect identity_status, identity_name_conflict and rank_reason before choosing an entity.

query.description: Company name prefix, company number or stable entity_ref.

tools.name: lansary_coverage
tools.description: Free. Counts of companies and sections held in the Lansary estate.

tools.name: lansary_company_availability
tools.description: Free preflight: which sections and evidence Lansary holds for a company before paying.

entity_ref.description: entity_ref returned by lansary_search_companies; used if reference_token is absent.

tools.name: lansary_company_synthesis
tools.description: Full company synthesis. First 3 company-record calls per UTC day per client are free (result includes free_allowance). After that: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 v2; without payment this returns the x402 PaymentRequired challenge and no data is returned until payment settles. Unknown companies return not-found and are never charged.

entity_ref.description: entity_ref returned by lansary_search_companies; used if reference_token is absent.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 PaymentPayload (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value), for clients that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"].
